purpose: Single predeclared regularized weight-training trial after the expanded candidate introduced control regressions
supervised_loss: Cross entropy on reviewed training targets only
regularizer: Forward KL( frozen base distribution || adapted model distribution ) on nonpadding teacher-forced training tokens only
kl_reduction: Sum over vocabulary, mean over nonpadding target tokens; do not divide by vocabulary size
newly_opened_test_role: Now inspected, evaluation-only known control; not called a fresh blind test again
selection_rule: Evaluate validation first, then the same previous controls; do not train on their errors or install a model that introduces new content losses
optimization_mode: Teacher and student both use eval mode to disable base and adapter dropout; adapter gradients remain enabled. This is not a causal ablation of KL alone versus8032.
